component.name: Hebrew Bear
component.summary: Hebrew vocabulary with root-based verb conjugation

description.p: A personal Hebrew vocabulary book. Verbs are stored as a root plus a binyan and their forms are generated on demand; nouns and adjectives are stored as written.

The conjugation rules cover the regular patterns along with several weak root classes, four-letter roots and the Hitpael metathesis. Where a verb is genuinely irregular, any single form can be corrected by hand and the correction is kept.
